## Advocacia — Operacional
Saúde da API/Worker, outbox, jobs e consumers. Métricas vêm do Meter `Advocacia` (ver docs/observability/metrics.md).

content.title: Requisições por minuto e taxa de erro (%)
content.query:
requests
| summarize total = count(), errors = countif(toint(resultCode) >= 500) by bin(timestamp, 5m)
| extend errorRatePercent = round(100.0 * errors / total, 2)
| project timestamp, total, errorRatePercent

content.title: Latência HTTP P50/P95/P99 (ms)
content.query:
requests
| summarize p50 = percentile(duration, 50), p95 = percentile(duration, 95), p99 = percentile(duration, 99) by bin(timestamp, 5m)

content.title: Outbox pendente
content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == 'outbox.pending.count'
| summarize pending = max(value) by bin(timestamp, 5m)

content.title: Outbox publicada x falhas
content.query:
customMetrics
| where name in ('outbox.processed.count', 'outbox.failed.count')
| summarize total = sum(valueSum) by name, bin(timestamp, 15m)

content.title: Jobs com falha (por job)
content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == 'jobs.failed.count'
| extend job = tostring(customDimensions['job'])
| summarize failures = sum(valueSum) by job, bin(timestamp, 1h)

content.title: Consumers com falha (por consumer)
content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == 'consumers.failed.count'
| extend consumer = tostring(customDimensions['consumer'])
| summarize failures = sum(valueSum) by consumer, bin(timestamp, 1h)

content.title: Endpoints mais lentos (P95 ms)
content.query:
requests
| summarize p95Ms = percentile(duration, 95), calls = count() by name
| where calls > 10
| top 15 by p95Ms desc

content.title: Exceções por tipo
content.query:
exceptions
| summarize count() by type, bin(timestamp, 1h)

content.title: Dependências com falha
content.query:
dependencies
| where success == false
| summarize failures = count() by target, type
| top 20 by failures desc

content.title: Disponibilidade (/health/ready)
content.query:
availabilityResults
| summarize availabilityPercent = round(100.0 * countif(success == true) / count(), 2) by bin(timestamp, 15m)
